components.name: Approve button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent,#b94e16);border-radius:6px;color:white;background:var(--accent,#b94e16);font-size:12px;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease;}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-dark,#963b0e);}.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94e16);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Attach tab button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#c8c1b7);border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink,#292723);background:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-size:12px;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease;}.ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--soft,#f1efec);}.ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94e16);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Stop button

components.name: Task composer
components.description: Multiline drafting surface; the border carries focus.
components.css: .ds-composer{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#c8c1b7);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);transition:border-color 160ms ease;}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent,#b94e16);}.ds-composer-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--ink,#292723);font-size:12px;font-weight:550;}.ds-task{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;width:100%;min-height:72px;max-height:180px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;outline:none;resize:vertical;color:var(--ink,#292723);background:transparent;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;caret-color:var(--accent,#b94e16);}.ds-task::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#6c675f);}.ds-task:focus-visible{outline:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-composer{transition:none;}}

components.name: Command menu
components.description: A raised, scrollable listbox above the composer.
components.html: Shortcuts
components.css: .ds-menu{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;max-height:min(360px,45dvh);padding:6px;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgb(41 39 35 / 16%);}.ds-menu-heading{padding:6px 8px 10px;color:var(--muted,#6c675f);font-size:11px;font-weight:550;}.ds-option{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink,#292723);background:transparent;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;}.ds-option[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--soft,#f1efec);}.ds-option>span{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:2px;}.ds-option strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:550;}.ds-option span span{color:var(--muted,#6c675f);font-size:11px;}.ds-option:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94e16);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Public decision summary
components.description: A disclosure for a safe public summary, separate from actions and verification.
components.html:
Decision summary

Review the available information before continuing.
components.css: .ds-decision{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft,#f1efec);color:var(--ink,#292723);}.ds-decision summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;list-style:none;}.ds-decision summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}.ds-decision summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94e16);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-decision summary svg{transition:transform 160ms ease;}.ds-decision[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(90deg);}.ds-decision p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#6c675f);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-decision summary svg{transition:none;}}

components.name: Page activity badge
components.description: Presentation-only feedback on an owned, actively running page.

narrative.overview:
A quiet browser workspace following the user's Comet reference. White and warm offwhite surfaces keep the page primary; compact controls frame an open activity feed and a bottom-anchored composer. System type, fine separators, and small corners make the interface feel familiar and precise.

Orange identifies sending and agent activity, with restrained supporting use for focus, attachment cues, and approval emphasis. Green and red retain their existing connection, verification, and failure meanings. Public decision summaries, actions, and verification stay visibly distinct.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with ink text and muted supporting copy.
Open chronological activity rather than a stack of decorative cards.
A persistent multiline composer with removable reference chips.
Small, purposeful motion with a steady reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Activity Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve strong orange emphasis for sending, running activity, and approval attention; use neutral surfaces for ordinary controls and references.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and fine separators for structure. Lift only the command menu and page activity badge.

dos: Do keep public decisions, actions, and verification distinguishable in the activity feed.
Do keep the composer at the bottom while the activity region scrolls independently.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, selected-option visibility, readable wrapping, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep reference selection visually distinct from explicit tab attachment and control.
donts: Don't turn ordinary controls or reference chips into orange calls to action.
Don't add decorative cards, gradients, display fonts, or entrance choreography to this quiet workspace.
Don't present a public decision summary as hidden reasoning or the page indicator as browser observation or control.
